dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.description: Export fixtures with broadcasts and prices, competitions with organizer logos, or clubs and other organizations with logos.

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Sport ID such as football or formula1.

kind.title: Competition type
kind.description: Filter by league, cup, series or tournament.

leagueCountry.title: League country
leagueCountry.description: Two-letter code for the country of the competition.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter broadcast market for fixtures or home country for organizations.

organization.title: Organization ID
organization.description: Club or other organization ID. In a fixture export, filter by participant.

organizationKind.title: Organization type
organizationKind.description: Filter the organizations dataset by type.

from.title: From
from.description: First fixture date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.title: To
to.description: Last fixture date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

broadcastsOnly.title: Only currently listed broadcasts
broadcastsOnly.description: Omit fixtures without a current listing for the selected broadcast country.

maxRecords.title: Maximum records
maxRecords.description: Fail before exporting if the result exceeds this limit.
